verdict.rationale: OpenCode is an AI coding agent operated through natural-language prompts. Users can ask it to fix issues or implement features, and it will open a branch and PR. They can also pass plain-language tasks via `opencode run "..."`, @mention agents in messages, or comment `/opencode` on GitHub. Community users confirm using it as their primary harness, though some report failed tool calls and unreliable file edits with local models. Missing for 10: evidence that product settings and configuration can be controlled by natural language (these are shown via keys, CLI and config), and consistent reliability of natural-language-driven edits across models.
